name: LineWaves-TS-TW
title: Line Waves
description: A black field is covered in thin, closely spaced white lines that curve together in long waves. The waves flow continuously, and the pointer parts them in a soft bulge where it rests.
use: A dark, premium-looking hero needs gentle organic motion with no content of its own.
avoid: You need to read lots of text over it: the bright white line clusters cross the whole frame.
a11y: Decorative and never still, with no reduced-motion query, so the flow runs regardless of preference. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Dense parallel hairlines, mostly white with the faintest blue cast, bending in sweeping diagonal curves. Gaps between the lines open into broad black valleys, and the whole field is soft and blurry at the edges.
behaves: The line field ripples and folds at a steady pace, with bands of lines bunching and spreading as they travel. Moving the pointer pushes a local warp through the lines that follows the cursor and eases back when it leaves.
customise: Line counts for the inner and outer bands, speed, warp amount, rotation, colour cycle, brightness, three colours and pointer strength are props.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader evaluates warped noise per pixel every animation frame.
